changes.description: Create a container for all synth modules with vintage styling (metal texture, border, title, and virtual screws).

considerations: The component must be flexible to wrap any module content.
It should accept a 'title' prop to display the module name.
The styling should be easily adaptable.

changes.description: Create a vertical slider component for controls like mixer levels and envelope ADSR. It should have a vintage fader cap design.

considerations: The slider needs to be responsive and work smoothly with mouse/touch events.
It should be stylistically consistent with the vintage theme.

changes.description: Implement a new, more realistic and space-efficient knob design. Add tick marks around the knob for a more analog feel and refine the value display.

considerations: The new design must not break existing functionality.
The clickable area for value editing should remain clear and usable.
Performance should be monitored, as many knobs will be on screen.

changes.description: Overhaul the main layout to create the 4-column 'rack' structure. Add the textured background and wooden side panels. Implement responsive breakpoints for tablet and mobile.
Add global styles for the rack background, textures, and other vintage UI elements.

considerations: The layout must be flexible and use CSS Grid or Flexbox to handle responsiveness.
The change from a fixed-width to a full-screen layout needs to be tested across different screen sizes.

changes.description: Create a new module for mixing the three oscillators and a new noise source. It will use the new Slider and ModuleContainer components.
Add state management for the mixer levels and the noise generator.

considerations: The mixer is a critical new piece of the audio engine; its integration must be flawless.
The noise source should have a selectable color (white/pink).

steps.description: Redesign and relocate the Oscillator modules.

changes.description: Redesign the layout to be more compact and vertically oriented, using the new Knob and ModuleContainer. Stack the three oscillator modules in the first column of the new rack layout.
Update the main layout to place the redesigned oscillator sections in the first column.

considerations: The vertical stacking needs to look clean and not cramped.
Ensure all controls are still easily accessible.

changes.description: Group all master controls (volume, power, transpose, etc.) into a dedicated master module in the fourth column.

considerations: The master section should be clearly delineated from the sound-shaping modules.

steps.description: Redesign the Filter and Envelope modules.

changes.description: Redesign the filter modules to be more compact and stack them in the second column.
Redesign the envelope modules, potentially using sliders for ADSR, and stack them below the filters.

considerations: Using sliders for envelopes can be more intuitive than knobs and reinforces the vintage aesthetic.

changes.description: Redesign the LFO modules and stack them in the third column.

considerations: The LFO rate visualization should be clear and easy to understand.

steps.description: Create and integrate the Modulation Matrix.

changes.description: Create a new component for a simple modulation matrix to route LFOs and envelopes to various destinations.
Integrate the ModulationMatrix component into the third column.
Update the synth engine to handle the new modulation routings.

considerations: The matrix should be simple to start: a dropdown-based source/destination/amount system.
This is a major UX improvement and should be designed for clarity.

changes.description: Create a new module for basic delay and reverb effects.
Integrate the effects into the audio signal chain.
Add the EffectsSection to the master column.

considerations: Start with simple, effective algorithms for delay and reverb.
The effects should be the last step in the signal chain before the master volume.

changes.description: Review the entire application for consistency, responsiveness, and visual polish. Adjust spacing, typography, and colors as needed.

considerations: Pay close attention to the feel of the interactions.
Test thoroughly on all target screen sizes (desktop, tablet, mobile).
Ensure the vintage aesthetic is cohesive across all new components.
